title: Keep each CAP message once seen
summary: incident.graph@ asks that weather/cap.json keep every message once seen: most "replaces" point at messages no longer in the feed, so what a warning was before its change is empty for 10 of 11 updates.
closes: cap.json keeps replaced messages, and the graph's was_level and was_starts fill.
